title_zh: ShadowFormer：全局上下文有助于图像阴影去除
problem_statement: Existing deep learning methods for image shadow removal often suffer from severe artifacts around shadow boundaries and inconsistent illumination because they focus locally and ignore the global contextual correlation between shadow and non-shadow regions.

contributions.text: We introduce a Retinex-based shadow model, which formulates the degradation of shadow and motivates us to exploit the global contexts for shadow removal.
We propose a new single-stage transformer for shadow removal (ShadowFormer) based on the multi-scale channel attention framework.
We propose a Shadow-Interaction Module with Shadow-Interaction Attention in the ShadowFormer to exploit the global contextual correlation between shadow and non-shadow regions.

The comprehensive experimental results on the public ISTD, ISTD+, and SRD datasets show that the proposed ShadowFormer achieved a new state-of-the-art performance with a very lightweight network, i.e., using up to 150x fewer model parameters.

method_overview: ShadowFormer is a lightweight, single-stage transformer-based network designed for end-to-end image shadow removal. It employs a multi-scale encoder-decoder architecture utilizing channel attention to efficiently capture hierarchical global information. At the bottleneck stage, a novel Shadow-Interaction Module (SIM) with Shadow-Interaction Attention (SIA) is introduced to model the global contextual correlation between shadow and non-shadow regions, thereby ensuring illumination consistency and reducing boundary artifacts.

key_formulas.semantic_desc: The Retinex-based shadow model decomposing the shadow image into shadow and non-shadow regions based on illumination and reflectance.
The Shadow-Interaction Attention mechanism that reweights the standard attention map using a correlation map to emphasize context between shadow and non-shadow patches.
The residual connection formulation within the Shadow-Interaction Module, combining channel attention, layer normalization, and shadow interaction attention.

key_figures.caption: Overview of the ShadowFormer network. The channel attention transformer-based encoder and decoder are to extract hierarchical information from the input shadow image, and to reconstruct the shadow-free image, respectively, using a series of channel attention (CA) modules. In the bottleneck stage, we adopt a Shadow-Interaction Module (SIM) to exploit the context information across both spatial and channel dimensions from non-shadow region to help shadow region restoration.
key_figures.role: Illustrates the overall architecture of the proposed ShadowFormer network, highlighting the encoder-decoder structure and the placement of the Shadow-Interaction Module.

key_figures.caption: The detailed architectures of ShadowFormer model components. (a) Channel Attention (CA) Module in the encoder and decoder. (b) Shadow-Interaction Module (SIM), as well as an illustration of Shadow-Interaction Attention (SIA). Reweighting the attention map by the correlation map between shadow and non-shadow patches to emphasize the contextual correlation between shadow and non-shadow regions.
key_figures.role: Details the internal mechanisms of the Channel Attention module and the Shadow-Interaction Module, specifically how SIA uses correlation maps.

key_figures.caption: The PSNR performance, v.s., the number of model parameters of shadow removal models on ISTD dataset.
key_figures.role: Demonstrates the efficiency of ShadowFormer by showing its superior PSNR performance with significantly fewer model parameters compared to state-of-the-art methods.

key_figures.role: Visualizes the correlation maps generated by the Shadow-Interaction Module to demonstrate how it captures relationships between shadow and non-shadow regions.

experiments.main_results: ShadowFormer achieves state-of-the-art performance on all three datasets while using up to 150x fewer model parameters than competing methods.
takeaways: The proposed method effectively alleviates contour artifacts and ensures illumination consistency by leveraging global context from non-shadow regions

full_analysis_md: # ShadowFormer: Global Context Helps Image Shadow Removal ## 1. Problem Statement Image shadow removal is challenging due to arbitrary shadow patterns and spatially non-uniform degradation, which leads to illumination and color inconsistencies between shadow and non-shadow regions. Existing deep learning methods often focus locally, resulting in boundary artifacts and ignoring the global contextual correlation necessary for consistent restoration. ## 2. Methodology The authors propose **ShadowFormer**, a lightweight, single-stage transformer-based network inspired by a novel **Retinex-based shadow model**. This model posits that shadow and non-shadow regions share the same underlying reflectance ($\mathbf{R}$) but differ in illumination ($\mathbf{L}_s$ vs $\mathbf{L}_{ns}$). Therefore, restoring the shadow-free image requires exploiting the global context from non-shadow regions to guide shadow restoration. ### Key Components: - **Multi-scale Channel Attention Framework**: An encoder-decoder architecture using Channel Attention (CA) modules to efficiently capture hierarchical global information without excessive computational cost. - **Shadow-Interaction Module (SIM)**: Located at the bottleneck stage, this module introduces **Shadow-Interaction Attention (SIA)**. SIA reweights the standard attention map using a correlation map between shadow and non-shadow patches. This allows the network to explicitly model the contextual correlation across spatial and channel dimensions, ensuring that information from the clear, non-shadow regions guides the restoration of the shadowed areas. ## 3. Experiments and Results Extensive experiments were conducted on three public datasets: **ISTD**, **ISTD+**, and **SRD**. - **Performance**: ShadowFormer achieves state-of-the-art performance in terms of PSNR and visual quality. - **Efficiency**: The model is significantly lighter than existing methods, using up to **150x fewer model parameters** while outperforming them. - **Visual Quality**: The method effectively reduces boundary trace artifacts and maintains better illumination and color consistency compared to previous works. ## 4. Conclusion ShadowFormer demonstrates that leveraging global contextual correlation through a specialized attention mechanism (SIA) within a lightweight transformer architecture is highly effective for image shadow removal. By adhering to the physical principles of the Retinex-based shadow model, it successfully restores shadow-free images with high fidelity and efficiency. ## 5. Code Availability The code for ShadowFormer is publicly available at: https://github.com/GuoLanqing/ShadowFormer
